\item[] \textit{Note:} Log preferences, $\rho = 1$. One block per specification of the cost, each at its U.S.\ calibration (table \ref{table:US_ESC:variants}). Every row is a separate equilibrium path read in 2020, with the changed characteristic holding over the whole horizon and the political choice binding from the first period. ``Pinned'' holds the design at $\theta^{\ast}$ and ``chosen'' lets the electorate choose it one period in advance, both under the cost. The ageing scenarios are those of section \ref{sec:oecd}; the two composite rows impose France\textquotesingle s income distribution and voting patterns together and, in the second, also its level of $X$. The France row is France\textquotesingle s own calibrated path at its observed design $\theta = 1$, where none of the three costs bites, and has no chosen reading. The savings rate is savings relative to GDP: its level on the baseline row and, on every other row and in both columns, the change against the baseline with the design chosen, in percentage points. The workweek is in hours.
\end{tablenotes}
